name: Hijri Format
description: Displays dates in the Hijri (Islamic) calendar, with Umm al-Qura adjustment.
project_description:
A simple module that converts dates to Hijri format, The module adds a display format for created and changed fields for Nodes and Comments entities, and Date fields for all entity types.

 Module Features: 
 
 
 Custom Formats 
 You are not restricted to a predefined list of formats, build your own date format.

 
 
 Support for Umm Ulqura 
 You can adjust the date to match Umm Ulqura, the official calendar of the Kingdom of Suadi Arabia.

 
 
 Multilingual Support 
 We aren't using 3rd party libraries for translation, this module built with an eye on translation.
 

 
 
 Indian numbers 
 Option to show date with Indian numbers.
 

 
 
 Current date block 
 Add as much as you need from the current date block, with the custom format you define.
